text:
olivia: quick heads-up — ran the weekly access-validation job against KMS delegations and found an unexpected grant to svc-data-sync@redwood-prod. not in the owners list.
maria: thanks — is that a long-lived key or an ephemeral role? any recent deploys that might've requested it?
olivia: looks like a IAM binding on the KMS key (projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/kr-main/cryptoKeys/ck-logs). binding created ~2w ago by azure-sync pipeline. TTL not set.
chris: can you paste the audit-log query you used? want to cross-check with token exchange events.
olivia: sure — query used:
```
resource.type="kms_key"
protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy"
resource.labels.key_ring_name="kr-main"
timestamp >= "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"
```
maria: if it's a SetIamPolicy with a pipeline service account, likely the deploy step added it. but we should treat as principle-of-least-privilege violation until confirmed.
leo: quick vuln-triage note — svc-data-sync has a recently disclosed dependency vuln in its npm lib that could allow token exfiltration if attacker controls build. not saying it was exploited, but we should assume worst-case and rotate keys.
jordan: propose plan: (1) temporary revoke the KMS grant (canary to one region first), (2) rotate any affected key material, (3) run post-rotation validation and replay audit logs, (4) schedule a blameless RCA for the pipeline that added it. window? 30m for canary?
maria: +1 for canary. we should also check audit-log ingestion — noticed some gaps last week where log ingestion lagged ~45m. if logs are missing we might blind ourselves.
chris: pinging @sre-bot to surface ingestion metrics and any recent GCS export failures.
sre-bot: alert: logging-export-failure detected 2026-03-12T03:18:24Z -> GCS bucket redwood-logs-archive; retry count 3. last successful export 2026-03-12T02:30:19Z. Link: https://go/retry-logs
olivia: ok if ingestion has gaps we should hold off final rotation until we have a continuous record of SetIamPolicy and token exchange events for the window. but we can still revoke the principal binding in a canary region.
leo: commands to revoke (gcloud example):
```
# remove member from key IAM
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding ck-logs \
  --location=global --keyring=kr-main \
  --member=serviceAccount:svc-data-sync@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```
jordan: I'll own the canary revoke and rotation. i'll run it in us-west1 first and post the result. target start: in 15m. tagging incident channel in case of downstream issues.
maria: also, let's add checklist for private-key handling: force new key version, invalidate all cached secrets in prefix caches, and notify any downstream owners to re-encrypt configs.
chris: one more ask — after rotation, add a preventive guard in the deploy pipeline: require explicit approver for SetIamPolicy to prod KMS keys, and add short TTLs by default for delegated grants.
olivia: agreed. I'll open a short RFC for pipeline change and link it here. also adding automated periodic sampling — every monthly access review should run a diff vs owners list and open a PR if unexpected grants exist.
leo: on vuln side i'll open a ticket to patch svc-data-sync and add SCA gating in CI.
jordan: canary revoke complete: us-west1 revoke succeeded, no immediate downstream failures observed. rotating key now (creating new key version and re-encrypting). will post key rotation log.
sre-bot: notice: key-rotation-job started by jordan at 2026-03-18T15:42:10Z. job id krot-20260318-7.
olivia: thanks. action items captured: jordan (canary + rotation), leo (patch svc-data-sync + SCA), chris (pipeline guard RFC), maria (owners list reconciliation), olivia (monthly diff job + RFC for deploy approval). i'll schedule a 1hr post-mortem tomorrow to review follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
maria: tagging compliance for audit trail: @compliance-team please note possible KMS binding deviation for 2026-03-01..2026-03-18 window.
chris: added a quick dashboard to monitor SetIamPolicy spikes and missing audit logs: https://go/kms-audit-dash
olivia: thanks all — closing thread for now, reopen if any anomalies show up after rotation.
